$comment: Output of developer.review_feasibility. Sent to the model as the structured output format; one rating per design item (open questions excepted) and citations are enforced in code (app/modules/design_reviews/rules.py).

summary.description: A few sentences on how buildable the design is, the overall effort, and the main concerns.

findings.description: One rating per design item except open questions, in design order.

design_item.description: The design item ID, e.g. CMP-001.

complexity.description: Implementation effort: S (days), M (one to two weeks), L (more).

assessment.description: Why it can or cannot be built as described with the chosen technology.

recommendation.description: For concerns or not_feasible: what would resolve it. Empty otherwise.

related_items.description: IDs of other design items this rating depends on.

unverified_capabilities.description: Capabilities the rating assumes but the inputs do not confirm.

ref.description: REV-n of the review comment answered.
